messages:
Priya: quick design sync tomorrow 10am PT on trace header actions + export UX. tiny scope: copy/correlation/permalink placement, export menu behavior, and accessibility text.
Lena: sounds good. can you summarize the current proposal so I can prep keyboard flows?
Priya: prototype: left-most: Copy Correlation ID (primary), center title, right-side: permalink, kebab menu with exports (Download HAR / CSV / Request async export), and an overflow for 'Open in new tab'. we also want to add explicit aria-labels and a visible focus ring.
Omar: engineering note: Copy action should annotate analytics with runtime id and model version. easiest is a data attribute on the button. also large trace exports must be async; we can't block the UI thread.
Jules: a11y checklist: 1) each button needs aria-label not icon-only 2) kebab menu needs role=menu and keyboard support (arrow keys, Home/End) 3) toasts must use aria-live polite.
Ben: UX question: if export is async, do we show 'Request export' in the menu or keep 'Download' and then show a spinner? I worry users expect immediate download when it says Download.
Priya: leaning toward dynamic labeling: menu item text switches to 'Request export (async)' for traces > 5MB. For discoverability we show an info tooltip: 'Large traces are exported asynchronously and will appear in Notifications when ready.'
Lena: if label changes dynamically, add an announcement for screen readers: aria-live="polite" text like 'Export mode: async'. otherwise blind users might be confused.
Omar: backend will add an export-status endpoint; UI can poll and show a toast when ready. will emit export_id for tracking.
Jules: also for stacktrace rows: collapse chevrons must be buttons with aria-pressed and descriptive labels like 'Collapse frame at index 3'. avoid 'toggle' wording.
Ben: keyboard flow: tab order should be left actions -> title -> right actions -> kebab. opening kebab should move focus into the menu; Esc closes and returns focus to kebab button. I'll prototype in dev playground.
Priya: decision points for tomorrow: 1) header vs side-panel for exports 2) exact copy for async state and tooltip 3) final ARIA strings for copy/permalink/kebab and chevrons 4) QA checklist for export race conditions.
Omar: backend prefers header (fewer context fetches). if design wants side-panel, we need caching for export metadata.
Lena: I'll prepare NVDA/VoiceOver test steps and example ARIA labels.
Jules: I'll draft the menu keyboard spec (arrow navigation, Home/End, typeahead) and share before the meeting.
deploy-bot: Playground build 1850055568 deployed (branch: trace-header-export-a11y).
Priya: great work — see you all 10am. please drop any pre-reads in the thread. :thumbsup:
